title: Complex harmonic mean
summary: We study the harmonic mean of non-zero complex-valued random variables (complex harmonic mean) and establish several geometric estimates and bounds. In contrast to the classical positive-valued case, complex harmonic means may lie outside the convex hull of the range. We prove that if the range is contained in a disk not containing the origin, then the complex harmonic mean is confined to the same disk.
